name: jira_issue_assign
description: Assigns an issue to a user (PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/assignee)

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue to assign, for example RECON-102.

assignee.description: The display name of the user the issue is assigned to, for example Grace Liu.

assignee_email.description: The email address of the assignee, for example grace.liu@morganstanleysimulated.com.
